title: Tumor suppressor NME1/NM23-H1 modulates DNA binding of NF-κB RelA
authors: Shandy Shahabi; Mano Maurya; Shankar Subramaniam; Gourisankar Ghosh
one_liner_zh: 该文研究NME1作为辅因子增强NF-κB RelA与κB位点DNA结合，涉及TF-DNA互作但以实验为主，缺乏AI或物理模拟方法，仅部分契合课题。
abstract: The dimeric NF-κB family of transcription factors activates transcription by binding sequence-specifically to DNA response elements known as κB sites, located within the promoters and enhancers of their target genes. While most NF-κB remain inactive in the cytoplasm of unstimulated cells, a small amount of RelA, one of its members, persists in the nucleus, ensuring low-level expression of genes essential for homeostasis. Several cofactors have been identified that aid in DNA binding of RelA. In this study, we identify NME1 (nucleoside diphosphate kinase 1) as a cofactor that enhances RelA’s ability to bind κB sites within the promoters of a subset of its target genes, promoting their expression under both unstimulated and stimulated conditions. Depletion of NME1 influences activation or repression of several genes that are unresponsive to TNFα, despite containing κB sites in their promoters but not in clusters. This suggests that clustering of kB sites may be necessary for RelA-dependent transcription complex assembly. NME1 appears to act as a cofactor for other transcription factors to regulate these genes. NME1 does not directly contact κB DNA but interacts with RelA, with this interaction being further strengthened in the presence of κB DNA. Notably, NME1 alone has a marginal effect in enhancing RelA’s DNA binding, suggesting that NME1 likely cooperate with other cofactors to regulate DNA binding and transcription through RelA. These observations underscore the intricate assembly of transcription complexes centered on NF-κB.
abstract_zh: 二聚体NF-κB转录因子家族通过序列特异性结合至其靶基因启动子和增强子中的κB位点DNA反应元件来激活转录。尽管在未受刺激的细胞中，大多数NF-κB在细胞质中保持非活性状态，但其成员之一RelA有少量持续存在于细胞核中，确保维持稳态所必需基因的低水平表达。已鉴定出多种辅助因子有助于RelA的DNA结合。在本研究中，我们确定NME1（核苷二磷酸激酶1）为一种辅助因子，能增强RelA结合其靶基因子集启动子内κB位点的能力，从而在未受刺激和受刺激条件下促进这些基因的表达。NME1的耗竭影响若干对TNFα无响应基因的激活或抑制，尽管这些基因的启动子中含有κB位点，但并非成簇存在。这表明κB位点的成簇可能对于RelA依赖性转录复合物的组装是必需的。NME1似乎作为其他转录因子的辅助因子来调控这些基因。NME1不直接接触κB DNA，而是与RelA相互作用，且在存在κB DNA时这种相互作用进一步增强。值得注意的是，单独NME1在增强RelA的DNA结合方面效果甚微，提示NME1可能与其他辅助因子协同作用，通过RelA调控DNA结合和转录。这些观察结果强调了以NF-κB为中心的转录复合物组装的复杂性。
